steps.description: Call OpenAPI Explorer:getApiOverview with id="openai" to retrieve the full list of operations and securitySchemes.
From the OpenAI overview, select every operation whose operationId contains "create"; for each, call OpenAPI Explorer:getApiOperation to extract requestBody.schema.required and count required fields.
Call OpenAPI Explorer:getApiOverview with id="github" to retrieve the full list of operations and securitySchemes.
From the GitHub overview, select every operation whose path begins with "/repos"; for each, call OpenAPI Explorer:getApiOperation to extract path/query/requestBody parameters and count required ones.
Extract and list each security scheme type (e.g. apiKey, oauth2) defined in both specs.
Compare the two specs and produce a consolidated JSON report (authSchemes, createOperations, repoOperations, crossComparison.operationsWithHighParamCount, crossComparison.commonSecurityTypes).
